name: Midnight opening range (NY local 00:00–00:30)

definitions.definition_text: Morning-session algorithmic opening range is specifically the 9:30–10:00 30-minute interval — if less than 30 minutes it is not algorithmic. The algorithm uses that first 30 minutes and does the same type of thing at midnight New York local time.
conditions: Midnight NY local analogue of NY AM OR logic
definitions.timeframe_session_context: NY AM 9:30–10:00 contrasted with midnight NY local 30m OR
definitions.variations_note: Reinforces modern 30m NY OR while introducing midnight OR as same-type construct — KEEP SEPARATE from Month 10 1h index/bond ORs.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Midnight Opening Range

definitions.definition_text: Midnight opening range is the 30-minute interval between midnight and 12:30 Eastern. Framing on 1-minute chart: mark midnight candle and 12:30 to obtain the midnight opening range.
conditions: 1m chart framing with verticals at midnight and 12:30
definitions.variations_note: Primary clock definition for midnight OR. Reinforced again ~00:46 and ~00:48 in same lecture.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Midnight Opening Range

definitions.definition_text: Three crucial reference points on the midnight candle / range: (1) opening price at midnight — midnight opening price for Power of Three (daily-range candlestick formation); (2) high of the midnight opening range; (3) low of the midnight opening range.
conditions: Track open, high, and low of the midnight OR
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Midnight OR geometry anchors + Power of Three open
definitions.variations_note: Geometry triad; Power-of-Three midnight open is related but not identical to OR high/low — kept in one occurrence as lecture presents them together.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Midnight Opening Range

definitions.definition_text: Fib measuring the midnight opening range (high→low): if the market trades above the range, it can go one-half of one standard deviation or one standard deviation (lecture walks -1 SD / projection settings from the midnight OR).
conditions: Midnight OR high/low graded with Fib / SD projections
Trade above midnight OR high → look for 0.5 / 1.0 SD extensions
definitions.variations_note: Related geometry (not ORG settlement Fib). KEEP SEPARATE from RTH ORG Fib 4:14→9:30 grading.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Midnight Opening Range

definitions.definition_text: Inside the midnight opening range, algorithm can rebook/redeliver premium and discount via first-presented displacement (first presented FVG-style displacement that 'jumps off the chart' inside the midnight OR).
conditions: Displacement forms inside midnight OR window
definitions.timeframe_session_context: 00:00–00:30 NY; FPFVG analogue inside midnight OR
definitions.variations_note: KEEP SEPARATE from NY 9:31 FPFVG and silver-bullet-after-10 variants; midnight-window first displacement only.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Midnight Opening Range

definitions.definition_text: Consequent encroachment of the midnight opening range — the 30-minute interval between midnight and 12:30 Eastern — is used as a delivery magnet (example path trades into CE of midnight OR).
conditions: CE = midpoint of midnight OR high/low
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Midnight OR CE (not RTH ORG CE)
definitions.variations_note: KEEP SEPARATE from consequent_encroachment_half_gap RTH-ORG ~70% claims — same CE vocabulary, different range object.

source.title: 2025 Lecture Series - SMC Midnight Opening Range

definitions.definition_text: Operational framing: on a one-minute chart place markers at the midnight candle and at 12:30 to obtain the midnight opening range; for a down-close midnight candle, the open of that body is the midnight opening price for Power of Three.
conditions: Down-close midnight candle → body open = midnight open
definitions.variations_note: How-to reinforcement of window + midnight open; complements three-refs occurrence.
